findings.detail: Exact existing effects and entire byte-reversal proof confine delta to two bindViewEvents branches. Native confirmation, account/view/render/month/root/signal guard, actual cancellation call and admin-only monthly entry remain unchanged. leave-approval request token/body/timeouts/acknowledgement/review reset and auth-generation decoder protection remain unchanged.

After accepted cancellation and original ownership guard, all desktop/mobile matching root action buttons receive Cancellation saved and disabled. textContent removes the spinner on the initiating button; retained stale state cannot normally replay the same cancellation. This does not newly prevent concurrent use of the other action copy before acceptance.

V1 marking exceptions escaped to mutation catch and could reset a confirmed action. V1r1 caught them truthfully but skipped parent notification. V1r2 isolates cosmetic marking in its own best-effort catch, then independently attempts confirmed()/closed(). Marking failure no longer suppresses that recovery notification or reclassifies a known accepted cancellation as mutation failure.

A marking fault may leave a spinner or another enabled copy until successful readback replaces rows. If parent GET fails, existing saved-but-stale notice and GET-only Retry are available when notification succeeds. If notification itself throws synchronously, saved-result catch gives explicit reopen-month fallback. This is not a guarantee against every arbitrary browser DOM or Promise failure.

Lifecycle is captured before opening actual monthly review and used only after existing accepted callback owner check. Calling closed here is a logical immediate action completion, not an actual approval-dialog close listener. Existing callback-before-dialog.close timing remains; refresh begins GETs then awaits. Verify real dialog removal/focus before async parent paint in all engines.

Existing createDependentParentLifecycle is byte-exact. It validates complete three-GET monthly read before committing, retains last-known data on failure, arbitrates owner/latest read, and its explicit Retry is read-only. Passing existing source through a new trigger still requires runtime matrix.

Accepted cancellation marking fault must still attempt parent notification and GET-only recovery. Notification failure must preserve one accepted POST and truthful saved/reopen state. No mutation-failure toast or mutation replay; bound spinner/copy state under fault until successful repaint.

Approval preview refusal/refresh/failure, disabled acknowledgement, Apply failure/uncertainty, unchanged Close/Escape, native cancel refusal, double activation and correct returned count/token/body. No confirmed parent read for unconfirmed decisions.

Separate calendar, requests and pressure GET failure/shape/wrong-month recovery if claiming all read failures; requests503 alone only proves that branch.
